texts.orig: Sentence 1 is the starting line as it introduces the main idea of the  parajumble,  i.e.  'Oceans  cover  more  than  70%  of  Earth's surface.'  Sentence  R  will  follow  sentence  1  as  it  states  that oceans  regulate global temperature and climate. And, sentence S states that they provide food and employment to millions. So, S will follow R. Further, sentence P talks about the importance of marine  species.  So,P  will follow S. However, sentence Q states that plastic waste threatens marine life. So, Q will follow P . Going through the options, option (a) has the correct sequence.
